items.highlights: TSMC September 2026 Revenue Report HSINCHU, Taiwan, R.O.C. – October 8, 2026 - TSMC (TWSE: 2330, NYSE: TSM) today announced its net revenue for September 2026: On a consolidated basis, revenue for September 2026 was approximately NT$511.86 billion, a decrease of 0.6 percent from August 2026 and an increase of 54.6 percent from September 2025. items.highlights: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) reported on October 8 that its third-quarter revenue reached a record NT$1.49 trillion (about US$46.7 billion), topping the high end of its own forecast as September sales held above NT$500 billion for a second straight month. The world's leading contract chipmaker said September revenue of NT$511.86 billion was 0.6% lower than August and 54.6% higher than a year earlier.
